name: Min-ji
source:
Pisces ◆ Café Part-timer

The heroine of the story.

A cautious girl living alone in the city for the first time. Devoted daughter and fantasy RPG player.

In another life, a more confident Min-ji might have chased her dreams of becoming a video game designer.
